title: High-Resolution Dynamic Functional Connectivity Generation with Graph-Variate Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.37037v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-resolution dynamic functional connectivity (DFC) can reveal rapidly evolving brain-network interactions, but short temporal windows yield noisy, often low-rank covariance estimates. Graph-Variate Dynamic (GVD) connectivity addresses this by modulating fast instantaneous interactions with stable trial-level support. This suppresses spurious fluctuations and emphasizes persistent, informative connections. We show that the Hadamard construction lifts low-rank instantaneous connectivity from the positive-semidefinite to the positive-definite cone, keeping high-resolution trajectories on the SPD manifold without ridge regularisation or post-hoc projection.   We introduce GVD-CFM, a class-conditional generative model for high-resolution dynamic connectivity. Each trial is represented as SPD GVD matrices on a product Riemannian manifold, then mapped through a global log-Euclidean diffeomorphism and an invertible temporal DCT basis. A Trans

translated_title: 基于图变量流匹配的高分辨率动态功能连接生成
translated_abstract: 高分辨率动态功能连接（DFC）能够揭示快速演化的脑网络交互，但短时间窗会导致噪声大且常常低秩的协方差估计。图变量动态（GVD）连接通过利用稳定的试验级支持来调制快速瞬时交互，从而解决这一问题，抑制虚假波动并强调持续且富含信息的连接。我们证明了Hadamard构造能将低秩瞬时连接从半正定锥提升至正定锥，使高分辨率轨迹保持在SPD（对称正定）流形上，而无需岭正则化或事后投影。我们提出了GVD-CFM，一种面向高分辨率动态连接的类条件生成模型。每次试验被表示为乘积黎曼流形上的SPD GVD矩阵，随后通过全局对数欧几里得微分同胚和可逆的时域DCT基进行映射。一个Trans……
tldr: 提出GVD-CFM，一种类条件流匹配生成模型，通过Hadamard构造将低秩瞬时连接提升为正定、将SPD矩阵映射到对数欧几里得空间，从而在不依赖岭正则化或事后投影的情况下生成高分辨率且保持SPD流形结构的动态功能连接。
en_tdlr: We propose GVD-CFM, a class-conditional flow-matching generative model that lifts low-rank instantaneous connectivity to the positive-definite cone via Hadamard construction and maps SPD matrices through a log-Euclidean diffeomorphism, generating high-resolution dynamic functional connectivity on the SPD manifold without ridge regularization or post-hoc projection.
